notable_candidates.summary: UMC says that if current tight supply-demand conditions persist, 2027 foundry price adjustments could be broader and more pronounced than the already-known 2H26 actions. This is recorded as an incremental pricing-power signal without inventing a 2027 hike percentage or earnings impact.

notes: Deduplicated against discovery latest state through 2026-09-20T20:56:12+08:00 and repository search for UMC/聯電 2027 pricing language; no prior discovery event ID for this incremental 2027 signal was found.

UMC's 2H26 price increases were already public earlier in 2026 and are not treated as a new event. The material delta is the newly reported company indication that 2027 adjustments could be broader and more pronounced if supply-demand tightness persists.

Powerchip's reported potential ~40% increase was not written as a separate new event because the company declined to confirm the market rumor and had already disclosed substantial DRAM and mature-node price increases in July 2026.

Neousys (6922) high B/B and semiconductor/defense demand commentary was reviewed but did not clear the material-change threshold versus prior company guidance that 2026 B/B would remain above 1 and order visibility extended through year-end.
Micron Taiwan labor-dispute reporting reviewed in this window did not yet provide a verified outcome from the September 21 mediation; no speculative Taiwan-listed competitor mapping was written.

No historical backfill, official numeric-series modification, normalized-fundamental modification, catalyst-probability modification or Fair Value modification was performed. Fair Value V2.1 remains the sole valuation baseline.
